page: Production deployment guide for Elysia servers. Cluster mode for multi-core CPU. Binary compilation with bun build --compile. Compile to JavaScript as alternative. Docker deployment with Distroless images. OpenTelemetry instrumentation for production. Monorepo support. Railway platform deployment. PORT environment variable handling. Multiple deployment strategies. Questions: How do I deploy Elysia to production? Should I use cluster mode? How do I compile to binary?

sections.manifest: Cluster mode for multi-core processors. Elysia single-threaded by default. cluster module from Node.js. os.availableParallelism() for CPU count. cluster.isPrimary for main process. cluster.fork() for worker creation. src/server.ts for actual server. Multiple CPU cores utilization. SO_REUSEPORT on Linux for port sharing. Questions: How do I use cluster mode? How do I enable multi-core? What is SO_REUSEPORT?

Binary compilation for production. bun build --compile command. Flags: --minify-whitespace, --minify-syntax, --target bun. --outfile server for output binary. Single portable binary generation. 2-3x memory reduction vs development. No Bun installation needed on server. Platform targets: bun-linux-x64, bun-linux-arm64, bun-windows-x64, bun-windows-arm64, bun-darwin-x64, bun-darwin-arm64, bun-linux-x64-musl, bun-linux-arm64-musl. Modern and Baseline variants. libc vs musl. AVX2 hardware requirement. chmod +x for execute permissions. --minify vs --minify-whitespace/--minify-syntax for OpenTelemetry. Questions: How do I compile to binary? What compile flags exist? What targets are supported?

JavaScript compilation as alternative. bun build without --compile. --minify-whitespace --minify-syntax. Single portable JavaScript file. NODE_ENV=production environment. Node.js or Bun runtime required. Windows compatibility when binary fails. Questions: How do I compile to JavaScript? When should I use JavaScript compilation?

Docker deployment strategy. Distroless base image from gcr.io. Multi-stage build with oven/bun. package.json and bun.lock caching. Binary compilation in build stage. Minimal runtime image. WORKDIR, COPY, ENV, CMD Docker directives. EXPOSE 3000 port. NODE_ENV=production setting. ./server executable running. OpenTelemetry instrumentation with --external flag. External module specification for pg npm packages. Dependencies vs devDependencies separation. bun install --production for prod only. Monorepo structure with Turborepo. apps/server/Dockerfile placement. docker build -f command for monorepo. Questions: How do I create a Docker image? How do I reduce image size? How do I handle monorepo builds?

Railway platform deployment. Railway.app platform. PORT environment variable assignment. process.env.PORT ?? 3000 fallback pattern. Hostname 0.0.0.0 automatic assignment. Questions: How do I deploy to Railway? How do I handle Railway's port assignment?
